events.title: Jimi Hendrix: Remembering a Legend
events.blurb: We mark the anniversary of the passing of guitar icon Jimi Hendrix, who died on this day in 1970 at the age of 27.

angles.name: Tribute to Jimi
angles.copy: Fifty-six years ago today, the music world lost an unparalleled talent. Jimi Hendrix's legacy continues to inspire generations. What's your favourite Hendrix track?

events.title: The Beatles' Abbey Road Anniversary
events.blurb: The Beatles released their eleventh studio album, 'Abbey Road', on September 26, 1969, featuring iconic tracks and that legendary zebra crossing cover.

angles.name: Abbey Road Memories
angles.copy: More than just an album cover, Abbey Road gave us some of The Beatles' most enduring songs. Which track is on repeat for you?

events.title: Chrissie Hynde turns 75
events.blurb: The inimitable Chrissie Hynde, frontwoman of The Pretenders, celebrates her 75th birthday today.

angles.name: Happy Birthday Chrissie
angles.copy: Wishing a very happy 75th birthday to the legendary Chrissie Hynde! Her voice and attitude remain as powerful as ever.

events.title: Liam Gallagher turns 54
events.blurb: Former Oasis and Beady Eye frontman Liam Gallagher celebrates his 54th birthday today.

angles.name: Happy Birthday Liam
angles.copy: Our kid turns 54 today! Wishing Liam Gallagher a very happy birthday. What's your favourite Oasis or solo track?

events.title: John Lennon's Imagine Album Anniversary
events.blurb: John Lennon's powerful and iconic solo album 'Imagine' was released in 1971.

angles.name: Imagine The Impact
angles.copy: More than just a song, 'Imagine' became an anthem. John Lennon's album continues to resonate decades later. What does it mean to you?

events.title: The First iPod Launched
events.blurb: Apple unveiled the original iPod on this day in 2001, forever changing how we listen to music.

angles.name: Remember The iPod
angles.copy: Twenty-five years ago, a little device called the iPod dropped and revolutionised our music libraries. How many songs did your first one hold?

events.title: Global James Bond Day
events.blurb: Global James Bond Day marks the anniversary of the world premiere of the first Bond film, 'Dr. No', in 1962.

angles.name: Bond, James Bond
angles.copy: Today is Global James Bond Day! Raise a martini (shaken, not stirred) to 007 and his enduring cinematic legacy. Which Bond is your favourite?

events.title: John Lennon would have been 86
events.blurb: We remember John Lennon, who would have celebrated his 86th birthday today.

angles.name: Remembering John Lennon
angles.copy: On what would have been his 86th birthday, we're celebrating the life and music of John Lennon. His vision continues to inspire.

events.title: John Cleese turns 87
events.blurb: Legendary comedian and actor John Cleese, of Monty Python and Fawlty Towers fame, celebrates his 87th birthday today.

angles.name: Happy Birthday John Cleese
angles.copy: Wishing a very happy 87th birthday to the comedic genius, John Cleese! What's your favourite Python sketch or Fawlty Towers moment?

events.title: The Beatles' White Album Anniversary
events.blurb: The Beatles released their iconic self-titled double album, universally known as 'The White Album', on November 22, 1968.

angles.name: White Album Deep Dive
angles.copy: Fifty-eight years since its release, The White Album remains a monumental and complex work. What's your hidden gem on this double LP?

events.title: Freddie Mercury: Remembering a Legend
events.blurb: We remember the extraordinary Freddie Mercury, who passed away on this day in 1991. He would have been 80 this year.

angles.name: Long Live Freddie
angles.copy: Thirty-five years ago, we lost a true icon. Freddie Mercury's voice and stage presence remain unmatched. What's your favourite Queen anthem?

events.title: The Beatles' Rubber Soul Anniversary
events.blurb: The Beatles released their influential sixth studio album, 'Rubber Soul', on this day in 1965.

angles.name: Rubber Soul Vibe
angles.copy: Fifty-one years of 'Rubber Soul'! The Beatles' album marked a pivotal shift in their sound. What's your favourite track from this classic?
